answers.customAnswer: Each WebSocket connection sends subscribe/unsubscribe messages with session IDs and event families. The daemon tracks only connection-local subscriptions, sends an immediate snapshot for subscribed scopes, then streams filtered deltas. When the connection closes, the daemon drops that connection's subscriptions.
answers.note:
Connection-local. Each socket manages its own subscriptions. No shared state between connections, no coordination, no complexity. A socket
  opens, subscribes to what it needs, gets events, closes, gone.
